reader.requirement: At --std 85 INITIALIZE acts as a series of elementary MOVEs: with REPLACING, each elementary item of identifier-1 (or identifier-1 itself if elementary) of a named category receives identifier-2/literal-1 by an implicit MOVE, every occurrence of every table included, excepting index data items, elementary FILLER and items subordinate to a REDEFINES within identifier-1 (GR3, GR4); identifier-1 may itself redefine.

edition-consulted.switches: WITH FILLER, TO VALUE, TO DEFAULT, THEN REPLACING are 2002 phrases refused at 85
ConstructRegistry.IsAvailable(initialize-variable-occurrence-2002): an ODO item under identifier-1 refused at 85 (SR4)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|DialectBehavior|IsActive|Edition. in InitializeBinder.cs, BoundInitialize.cs, InitializeEmitter.cs: only ctx.Edition.Error diagnostic sinks, no switch; expansion and MOVE emission are the same code at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: only admission (2002 phrases and ODO under identifier-1 refused at 85); the expansion of an admitted 1985 statement is the same code as at 2023
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf13_05 covers a flat group with one table and literal/identifier senders; not nested tables, FILLER and REDEFINES exclusion, index data items, JUSTIFIED and edited receivers from a signed scaled sender, ALL literal and figurative senders, a group sender, subscripted identifier-1, identifier-1 that itself REDEFINES, 18-digit values

reader.notes: The expansion visits every occurrence of nested tables, skips FILLER, index data items and subordinate REDEFINES, and stores through the MOVE converter (editing, scaling, sign, justification, ALL literals). The 2002-only forms are refused at 85 by VersionConformancePass, the only edition switch on the path.

refuter.evidence: Attack: GR2 says a series of MOVE statements, so a subscript of a later identifier-1 that an earlier identifier-1 changes is evaluated at its own MOVE. rini2-001 (--std 85): K=1, INITIALIZE K TE(K) REPLACING NUMERIC DATA BY 2 -> K=2 T=929 (TE(2) set); BY 3 -> K=3 T=993; four-category REPLACING on a group (ALPHANUMERIC BY identifier, NUMERIC BY 7, ALPHABETIC BY 'Q', NUMERIC-EDITED BY -5 into ZZ9) -> [xy07Q   5] (the edited receiver drops the sign as MOVE does); INITIALIZE G without REPLACING -> [  00    0] (GR5). Same at --std 2023. cite.py: OK §1985:VI.6.17.4 GR2 ("all operations are performed as if a series of MOVE statements had been written").
